title: Moment-Map Condition For Semisimple Theta Occurrence
body_html:
Moment-Map Condition For Semisimple Theta Occurrence

The theta draft uses the moment map

$$ M:W\to\mathfrak g $$

and its counterpart $M'$ for the other member of the dual pair.

Given a pre-semisimple character datum $\Sigma=(V,\beta,\phi)$, the basic occurrence condition is the existence of an element $w\in W$ such that

$$ M(w)=\beta. $$

When such a $w$ is fixed, the target semisimple datum is intended to have

$$ \beta'=-M'(w). $$

For a brick decomposition $\beta=\bigoplus_i\beta_i$, the draft writes

$$ w=\sum_i w_i, \qquad V'_i:=w_iV_i. $$

Draft Caution

The current TeX uses cited single-brick and multi-brick facts to justify nondegeneracy of $V'_i$ and blockwise decompositions of $V'$. Those facts are not proved inside the current theta draft.
